description: This file defines the ThemeService class which manages enabling and disabling themes and features within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for theme feature management, dependency handling, and notifications.

classes.name: ThemeService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing theme features, including enabling and disabling themes and their associated features within OrchardCore.

methods.name: DisableThemeFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Disables features for a specified theme, avoiding disabling the current theme.

methods.name: EnableThemeFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Enables features for a specified theme, processing base themes recursively.

methods.name: EnableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Enables a list of features, with an overload to include a force parameter.

methods.name: DisableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Disables a list of features, with an overload to include a force parameter.
